title: wolfssl_ec_xlat_err defined in header — each TU gets own rate-limit bucket
description: wolfssl_ec_xlat_err is defined as a (non-inline) static function in wolfssl_ec_key.h. Each .c file that includes the header gets its own copy with its own __ratelimit_state for pr_err_ratelimited. This means the rate limit for EC error logging is per-TU, not global, so the total log rate is N times the limit (N = number of includers). Currently N=2. Minor issue, but reinforces the case for moving to wolfssl_ec_key.c.
